stem: Which vitamin and its deficiency disease are correctly matched?

verdicts.working: Vitamin B₁ deficiency causes beriberi; the other listed pairings are incorrect.

working:

draft.distractor_notes:
A: Confuses vitamin D deficiency (rickets) with vitamin C deficiency (scurvy).
B: Confuses vitamin C deficiency (scurvy) with vitamin B$_1$ deficiency (beriberi).
